mapper.select: WITH outbound AS ( SELECT t.product_id, SUM(-t.qty) AS out_qty, SUM(t.amount) AS out_cost FROM inventory_txn t WHERE t.txn_type = 'out' AND t.product_id IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at::date >= #{from} AND t.created_at::date <= #{to} GROUP BY t.product_id ), inbound AS ( SELECT t.product_id, SUM(t.amount) AS in_cost FROM inventory_txn t WHERE t.txn_type = 'in' AND t.product_id IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at::date >= #{from} AND t.created_at::date <= #{to} GROUP BY t.product_id ), stock AS ( SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS stock_qty, SUM(i.qty * i.avg_cost) AS stock_amount FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.product_id ) SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, unit, out_qty, out_cost, stock_qty, stock_amount, avg_stock_amount, CASE WHEN avg_stock_amount <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(out_cost / avg_stock_amount, 2) END AS turnover_rate, CASE WHEN avg_stock_amount <= 0 OR out_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(CAST(#{days} AS numeric) / (out_cost / avg_stock_amount), 1) END AS turnover_days FROM ( SELECT p.id::text AS product_id, p.sku, p.name AS product_name, p.unit, ROUND(COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0), 3) AS out_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(o.out_cost, 0), 2) AS out_cost, ROUND(COALESCE(s.stock_qty, 0), 3) AS stock_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(s.stock_amount, 0), 2) AS stock_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(s.stock_amount, 0) + (COALESCE(o.out_cost, 0) - COALESCE(i.in_cost, 0)) / 2, 2) AS avg_stock_amount FROM product p LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN inbound i ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (COALESCE(s.stock_qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) > 0) ) base ORDER BY out_cost DESC, stock_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH stock AS ( SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS stock_qty, SUM(i.qty * i.avg_cost) AS stock_amount FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.product_id ), sales AS ( SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS sales_qty FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status IN ('approved', 'shipped', 'partial', 'closed') AND o.order_date >= #{from} AND o.order_date <= #{to} GROUP BY i.product_id ), last_out AS ( SELECT t.product_id, MAX(t.created_at)::date AS last_out_date FROM inventory_txn t WHERE t.txn_type = 'out' AND t.ref_type = 'sales' GROUP BY t.product_id ) SELECT p.id::text AS product_id, p.sku, p.name AS product_name, p.unit, ROUND(s.stock_qty, 3) AS stock_qty, ROUND(s.stock_amount, 2) AS stock_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(sa.sales_qty, 0), 3) AS sales_qty, lo.last_out_date, CASE WHEN lo.last_out_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CURRENT_DATE - lo.last_out_date)::int END AS stagnant_days FROM product p JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON sa.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN last_out lo ON lo.product_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.stock_qty > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.sales_qty, 0) ASC, s.stock_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH sales AS ( SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*)::int AS order_count, SUM(o.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(o.total_net) AS total_net, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount, SUM(o.total_profit) AS total_profit, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM sales_order o WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status IN ('approved', 'shipped', 'partial', 'closed') AND o.order_date >= #{from} AND o.order_date <= #{to} GROUP BY o.customer_id ), ar AS ( SELECT l.customer_id, SUM(l.remain_amount) AS ar_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status <> 'closed' AND l.due_date IS NOT NULL AND l.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN l.remain_amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_amount FROM ar_ledger l GROUP BY l.customer_id ) SELECT c.id::text AS customer_id, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, c.level, s.order_count, ROUND(s.total_qty, 3) AS total_qty, ROUND(s.total_net, 2) AS total_net, ROUND(s.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount, ROUND(s.total_profit, 2) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN s.total_net = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(s.total_profit / s.total_net, 4) END AS profit_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(a.ar_balance, 0), 2) AS ar_balance, ROUND(COALESCE(a.overdue_amount, 0), 2) AS overdue_amount, s.last_order_date FROM sales s JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN ar a ON a.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.total_amount DESC, s.total_profit DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id::text AS owner_id, COALESCE(e.real_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, COUNT(*)::int AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_net), 2) AS total_net, ROUND(SUM(o.total_cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(o.total_profit), 2) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(o.total_net) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(o.total_profit) / SUM(o.total_net), 4) END AS profit_rate FROM sales_order o LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = o.owner_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status IN ('approved', 'shipped', 'partial', 'closed') AND o.order_date >= #{from} AND o.order_date <= #{to} GROUP BY e.id, e.real_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT #{limit}
